methodology.scope: Local real PostgreSQL services with controlled pressure providers; this validates decision combination and delivery, not automatic resource detection or production capacity
methodology.mix: All critical, 60% orders / 20% catalog / 20% inventory; four SQL connections per service; no retries; open-loop scheduled arrivals
methodology.signal_policy: Threshold .8, max age 600ms, primary cap4/unknown cap2, secondary reject/unknown allow; poll100ms deadline50ms; settle350ms before counted load
